children.game_version: Rhythmic wrist and hip turning freeze game to dancehall beats without head spinning.

seniors.seated_version: Perform gentle waist and wrist rotations while seated firmly in a chair, omitting all neck circular movements.
seniors.standing_version: Slow waist and wrist isolations standing near a stable support, keeping feet flat and head static.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to slow pace; maintain limited motion range around the hips.

learning_units.description: Neck rotation movement isolated from hip gyration.
Simultaneous rotation of wrists, neck, and posterior.

social_formats.description: Solo dancer showcase or crew performance.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Continuous wrist rotations kept elevated or near the hips.
movement_profile.footwork: Rhythmic, bird-like leg movements shifting weight dynamically across the feet.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo centered, small group line, or circle showcase in dancehall settings.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Continuous, smooth gyration ('wine') of the waist, hips, and posterior.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low ground levels including squats and full splits; no high vertical jumps.
movement_profile.partnering: Primarily solo performance; can be performed in synchrony with a dance crew.
movement_profile.posture: Upright to deep squat position with fluid spine flexibility, allowing simultaneous isolations of head, wrists, and hips.

signature_moves.description: Continuous circular motion of the neck and head in rhythm with the music.
signature_moves.name: Neck Rotation

signature_moves.description: Dropping into full splits while maintaining posterior and head gyration.
signature_moves.name: Dutty Wine Splits

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid uncontrolled or jerky neck twisting; medical professionals warn of potential muscle trauma and ligament damage to the neck.

music_profile.musical_form: Riddim-based verse-chorus structure with repetitive rhythmic breaks.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Syncopated electronic dancehall riddim featuring heavy bass and sharp snare hits on offbeats.
music_profile.sound_description: Modern digital dancehall sound defined by driving electronic basslines, rapid snare patterns, and high-energy vocal delivery over a continuous riddim structure.
music_profile.vocal_style: Dancehall deejaying (toasting) with energetic vocal commands and rhythmic chanting.

basic_steps: Isolate waist and execute fluid circular posterior gyration ('wine')
Rotate wrists simultaneously in rhythm with hip movement
Step feet in rhythmic bird-like leg movements
Incorporate controlled continuous circular rotation of the neck
Advanced option: drop down into splits while maintaining neck and posterior rotations
teaching.formation: Solo, small group, or competitive circle showcase
teaching.level_notes: Beginners must master neck and waist isolations separately before integrating rapid head rotations due to physical strain risks.
teaching.rhythm: Up-tempo 4/4 syncopated dancehall riddim (Smash riddim beat)
